root: 这个词由「样本」一词加名词化后缀构成。该词是「例子」一词的缩略，源自拉丁 exemplum「样本、范型」，更早来自 eximere「取出」。统计抽样义在十九至二十世纪成形，信号采样与音频采样义为二十世纪发展；词源清楚，各义项最早记录年代不确定。

sensesIntro.en: Eight senses follow one taking method: statistical sampling, a single taking, a sample survey, field collection, production spot checks, audio sampling, signal sampling, and finally the subject taught in a statistics course.
sensesIntro.cn: 八个义项跟着同一种「取份」方法：统计抽样、单次取样、抽样调查、野外采集、生产抽检、音频采样、信号采样，最后是统计学课程里讲授的这门内容。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: flags placed by a grid on a field, each flag marking where one small portion of soil is taken.
core.cn: 核心意象：田里按方格插上小旗，每面旗标出取一小份土的位置。

branches.en: THE METHOD AND THE COURSE: choosing by rule, and the branch of statistics that teaches the rule.
branches.cn: 方法与课程：按规则挑选，以及讲授这套规则的统计学分支。

branches.en: THE ACT AND THE SURVEY: one taking, and the whole study that rests on such takings.
branches.cn: 动作与调查：一次取样，以及建立在这种取样之上的整个研究。

branches.en: THE FIELD BOTTLE: water, soil and air are carried away for later analysis.
branches.cn: 野外的瓶子：水、土与空气被带走供日后分析。

branches.en: THE FACTORY CHECK: a few bolts stand for a whole batch on the line.
branches.cn: 工厂的抽检：几颗螺栓替整批产品说话。

branches.en: THE TWO DIGITAL TAKINGS: a fragment of recorded sound and a slice of continuous signal.
branches.cn: 两种数字取样：一段录音片段与一段连续信号。

intro.en: Sampling is an English derivative: a clipped loanword plus the native ending -ing. The Latin list belongs to the base word.
intro.cn: sampling 是英语派生词：一个缩略借词加上本族后缀 -ing。拉丁词条属于它的基础词。

latinIntro.en: The Latin ancestors are exemplum, eximere and emere, all behind the base sample.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁祖先为 exemplum、eximere 与 emere，都在基础词 sample 背后。

items.example: The base word descends from this noun.
items.exampleCN: 基础词由这个名词传下。

items.example: The verb gives the physical picture of taking a portion.
items.exampleCN: 这个动词提供「取出一份」的身体画面。

items.example: The base word is shorter than its source.
items.exampleCN: 基础词比它的来源短。

items.example: The ending builds sampling, testing and measuring.
items.exampleCN: 这个后缀构成抽样、检验与测量等词。

items.example: The derived noun names the method.
items.exampleCN: 派生名词命名这套方法。

items.meaning: one who or that which samples
items.example: The agent suffix names the tool.
items.exampleCN: 施动后缀指工具。

items.example: The prefix marks a repeated round.
items.exampleCN: 前缀标出重复的一轮。

items.example: The prefix marks a level below the first taking.
items.exampleCN: 前缀标出低于第一次取样的层级。

items.meaning: sampling more than the usual share
items.example: The prefix marks an excess of one group.
items.exampleCN: 前缀标出某一群体的过量。

definition_zh: 加宽；使变宽；扩大；拓宽（范围、视野、兴趣等）
definition_en: to make something wider, or to increase its range, scope, variety, or inclusiveness
core_image: 把一条窄路的两侧各向外推一寸，路面随之变宽
scene: 这条路原本只够两人并行，拓宽后能走一辆卡车。 The teacher broadened the course from European history alone to include Asia and Africa, and the students' view opened with it.
sceneCN: 这里 broaden 是「拓宽、扩大」（第 2 个义项：扩大范围）；句意：老师把课程范围从只讲欧洲史拓宽到包含亚洲与非洲，学生的视野也随之打开。场景要点：课程大纲、世界地图、欧洲与亚非区域标注、学生笔记。

pos.zh: 加宽；扩大；拓宽
变宽；扩大；开阔起来

senses.title: Make physically wider
senses.definition: to make a road, river, opening, or surface wider from side to side
senses.definitionCN: 把道路、河流、开口或表面从一侧到另一侧加宽
senses.example: The council broadened the path so that two bicycles could pass.
senses.exampleCN: 市政会把小路加宽，好让两辆自行车并行。
senses.why: Broaden is broad plus the verb suffix -en, the same pattern as widen and deepen. The suffix here has a causative force: an agent makes the object broad, so the first sense is purely physical, with the distance between two edges increasing.
senses.whyCN: broaden 是 broad 加动词后缀 -en，与 widen、deepen 同一模式。这里的后缀带使役意味：施动者使宾语变宽，因此第一个义项纯粹是物理的，两条边之间的距离变大。

senses.title: Widen the range or scope
senses.definition: to increase the range of a study, inquiry, rule, or discussion so that it covers more
senses.definitionCN: 扩大研究、调查、规则或讨论的范围，使其覆盖更多内容
senses.example: The committee broadened the inquiry to include earlier failures.
senses.exampleCN: 委员会扩大了调查范围，把更早的失败也纳入其中。
senses.why: The physical edges become the boundaries of a subject. To broaden an inquiry is to move both limits outward, so that more cases fall inside; the same causative suffix now applies to an abstract object.
senses.whyCN: 物理的边变成主题的边界。扩大调查就是把两端的界限向外移，让更多案例落进范围内；同一个使役后缀现在作用于抽象宾语。

senses.title: Broaden the mind: knowledge and experience
senses.definition: to make a person's knowledge, interests, or experience more varied and less narrow
senses.definitionCN: 使一个人的知识、兴趣或经验更多样、更不狭窄
senses.example: A year abroad broadened her understanding of her own country.
senses.exampleCN: 在国外的一年拓宽了她对自己国家的理解。
senses.why: A narrow mind is imagined as a narrow space. Travel and study push the walls outward, which is why the fixed phrase is broaden someone's horizons: the horizon is the far edge of what can be seen.
senses.whyCN: 狭窄的心智被想象成一个狭窄的空间。旅行与学习把墙向外推，因此固定说法是 broaden someone's horizons：地平线就是所能看见的远边界。

senses.title: Widen the audience or appeal
senses.definition: to make something attractive or understandable to more people, not only to a small group
senses.definitionCN: 使某物对更多人具有吸引力或可理解，而不只面向小圈子
senses.example: The museum broadened its appeal by adding evening openings.
senses.exampleCN: 博物馆增加夜间开放，扩大了它的吸引力。
senses.why: The audience is the area covered. Broadening it means reaching groups that were outside the old edge, without changing the core of what is offered, so the edge metaphor extends from space to social reach.
senses.whyCN: 受众就是被覆盖的面积。扩大它就是触及旧边界之外的群体，而不改变所提供的核心内容，因此边界隐喻从空间延伸到社会触达。

senses.title: Make more inclusive
senses.definition: to increase who is included, admitted, or represented in an activity or institution
senses.definitionCN: 增加某项活动或机构所包含、接纳或代表的人群
senses.example: The programme was broadened to include students from rural schools.
senses.exampleCN: 该项目扩大到纳入乡村学校的学生。
senses.why: This is the scope sense applied to people. The boundary of the group moves outward, so broadening becomes a word for inclusion rather than for width, and the abstract sense gains a social value.
senses.whyCN: 这是范围义用在人身上。群体的边界向外移，于是 broaden 从“宽度”变成了“包容”，抽象义由此带上社会价值。

senses.title: Phrasal: broaden out into a wider form
senses.titleCN: 短语：broaden out 展开变宽
senses.definition: of a river, road, or shape, to become wider as it continues, often opening into a larger area
senses.definitionCN: 指河流、道路或形状在延伸中变宽，常展开成更大的区域
senses.example: Below the bridge, the river broadens out into a shallow lake.
senses.exampleCN: 桥下游，河流展开成一片浅湖。
senses.why: Out adds the idea of spreading open. The verb is intransitive here: nothing is being widened by an outside hand; the thing itself opens. This shows the inchoative side of -en, 'become broad' rather than 'make broad'.
senses.whyCN: out 添加“展开”的意思。这里动词是不及物的：没有外来的手把它加宽，而是事物自身展开。这体现了 -en 的起始义，即“变得宽”，而不是“使宽”。

senses.title: Usage boundary: broaden versus widen
senses.definition: widen is the usual verb for physical width; broaden is preferred for scope, knowledge, appeal, and inclusion
senses.definitionCN: widen 是物理宽度的常用动词；broaden 更常用于范围、知识、吸引力与包容性
senses.example: They widened the doorway, but broadened the discussion.
senses.exampleCN: 他们把门洞加宽，却把讨论拓宽了。
senses.why: Both mean 'make wide', but broad has long been the adjective for abstract extent, as in a broad view. That abstract life carried over to broaden and left widen with the concrete job.
senses.whyCN: 两者都表示“使宽”，但 broad 长期是表示抽象广度的形容词，如 a broad view。这种抽象生命延续到 broaden，把具体工作留给了 widen。

senses.title: Usage boundary: broaden versus expand and extend
senses.definition: expand stresses growth in size or volume in all directions; extend stresses length or duration; broaden stresses the widening of a range
senses.definitionCN: expand 强调体积或规模向各方向增长；extend 强调长度或时间的延伸；broaden 强调范围的加宽
senses.example: The firm expanded abroad, extended its contract, and broadened its product range.
senses.exampleCN: 这家公司向海外扩张，延长了合同，并拓宽了产品范围。
senses.why: Each verb keeps its own spatial image: a balloon expands, a line extends, and a range is broadened by pushing its side limits outward. The suffixes differ, so the verbs are not interchangeable.
senses.whyCN: 每个动词保留自己的空间意象：气球膨胀（expand），线延长（extend），而范围是靠把两侧界限外推来拓宽（broaden）。后缀不同，因此这些动词不能互换。

senses.title: Grammar boundary: transitive and intransitive
senses.titleCN: 语法边界：及物与不及物
senses.definition: broaden takes an object when someone widens something, and stands alone when something becomes wider by itself
senses.definitionCN: 有人把某物加宽时 broaden 带宾语；某物自行变宽时则单独使用
senses.example: They broadened the road; farther on, the road broadens.
senses.exampleCN: 他们把路加宽了；再往前，路自己变宽了。
senses.why: The -en suffix makes both readings possible: it can mean 'make wide' with an object, or 'become wide' without one. The context decides whether an agent is present.
senses.whyCN: -en 后缀让两种读法都成立：带宾语时表示“使宽”，不带宾语时表示“变宽”。语境决定是否存在施动者。

intro.en: Broaden is broad plus the native verb suffix -en, the same pattern that gives widen, deepen, and strengthen. Broad is an Old English adjective; the suffix is Germanic; the deeper prehistoric root of broad is not known with certainty. The earliest recorded dates are 1726 for the transitive and 1727 for the intransitive.
intro.cn: broaden 是 broad 加本土动词后缀 -en，与 widen、deepen、strengthen 同一模式。broad 是古英语形容词，后缀属日耳曼语；broad 更深的史前词源并不确定。最早记录年代为及物用法 1726 年、不及物用法 1727 年。

items.en: Old English brād meant 'wide, not narrow', and also 'flat, open, extended'. It covered physical width and open space from the start; the senses of daylight and of speech or accent developed later, in the late 14th and mid-15th centuries.
items.cn: 古英语 brād 意为“宽的、不窄的”，也表示“平坦的、敞开的、延展的”。它从一开始就覆盖物理宽度与开阔空间；白昼义与口音义则较晚，分别见于 14 世纪晚期与 15 世纪中期。

items.en: The adjective goes back to Proto-Germanic *braidi-, the source of Old Frisian bred, Old Norse breiðr, Dutch breed, German breit, and Gothic brouþs. Etymonline says its origin is unknown and it is not found outside Germanic; it also notes no clear distinction in sense from wide.
items.cn: 这个形容词上溯原始日耳曼语 *braidi-，也是古弗里斯语 bred、古诺斯语 breiðr、荷兰语 breed、德语 breit、哥特语 brouþs 的来源。etymonline 称其来源不明，且不见于日耳曼语族之外；它还指出 broad 与 wide 在意义上没有清晰区分。

items.en: -en is a native verb-forming suffix from Old English -nian, from Proto-Germanic *-inojan and a PIE adjectival suffix *-no-. It makes verbs from adjectives or nouns, usually with the sense 'make or become', as in darken, weaken, widen, and deepen. It was most active in Middle and early modern English.
items.cn: -en 是本土动词构词后缀，来自古英语 -nian，上溯原始日耳曼语 *-inojan 与原始印欧语形容词后缀 *-no-。它把形容词或名词变成动词，通常表示“使……或变得……”，如 darken、weaken、widen、deepen。它在古英语中较沉寂，在中古英语与早期现代英语中最活跃。

items.en: Etymonline dates broaden to 1726 for 'make broad' and 1727 for 'grow broad'. It says the word seems no older than this and was cited by Johnson in one of James Thomson's Seasons poems; broadened is also first found in the same poet. These are earliest recorded uses, not necessarily the coinage date.
items.cn: etymonline 把 broaden 的“使宽”义定在 1726 年，“变宽”义定在 1727 年。它称这个词似乎不会更早，约翰逊曾在詹姆斯·汤姆森的《四季》诗作中引用过；broadened 也最早见于同一位诗人。这些是最早记录用法，不一定是造词年代。

items.en: In the 19th century the verb spread from roads and rivers to scope, knowledge, sympathy, and audience, giving phrases such as broaden the mind and broaden one's horizons. The exact dates of these figurative extensions are not recorded, so the century is only an approximate frame.
items.cn: 19 世纪，这个动词从道路、河流扩展到范围、知识、同情心与受众，产生 broaden the mind、broaden one's horizons 等短语。这些比喻扩展的确切年代未见记录，因此该世纪只是大致框架。

items.en: Modern institutional English uses broaden for access, participation, appeal, and debate. The physical image remains underneath: two side limits are pushed outward. The verb keeps both the causative 'make broad' and the inchoative 'become broad'.
items.cn: 现代机构英语用 broaden 谈获取机会、参与、吸引力与讨论。底下的物理意象仍在：两条侧边界限被向外推。这个动词同时保留使役的“使宽”与起始的“变宽”。

note.en: The first group shares the broad root in adjective, adverb, and noun form; the second separates widening by range, by volume, by length, and by overall size.
note.cn: 第一组共享 broad 词根，分别为形容词、副词与名词形式；第二组按范围、体积、长度与整体规模区分“加宽”。

entries.definition: Wide, or large in range. It is the base adjective; broaden is the action of making something broad or becoming broad.
entries.definitionCN: 宽的，或范围广的。它是基础形容词；broaden 是使之变宽或变宽的动作。

entries.definition: In general terms, or over a wide range. It describes how something is meant, while broaden describes a change.
entries.definitionCN: 大体上，或广泛地。它描述某话是在什么意义上说的，而 broaden 描述变化。

entries.definition: The measurable width of something, or the range of a person's knowledge. It is the noun of broad, with a vowel change and the suffix -th.
entries.definitionCN: 可测量的宽度，或一个人知识的广度。它是 broad 的名词，伴随元音变化与后缀 -th。

entries.definition: The quality of being broad. It is the regular noun from the adjective, while breadth is the older irregular noun.
entries.definitionCN: 宽的性质。它是由形容词规则构成的名词，而 breadth 是更古老的不规则名词。

entries.definition: To make or become wider, especially in physical space. It is the default verb for roads, gaps, and openings.
entries.definitionCN: 使变宽，尤指物理空间。它是道路、缺口与开口的默认动词。

entries.definition: To grow larger in size, volume, or number. It suggests growth in all directions, like a balloon, not the pushing of two edges.
entries.definitionCN: 在尺寸、体积或数量上变大。它暗示像气球一样向各方向增长，而不是推两条边。

entries.definition: To make something longer in space or time. It stretches a line, while broaden pushes a range sideways.
entries.definitionCN: 在空间或时间上使更长。它拉长一条线，而 broaden 把范围向两侧推。

entries.definition: To make something larger overall, as in enlarge a photograph. It stresses total size rather than the width of a range.
entries.definitionCN: 使整体变大，如放大照片。它强调总体尺寸，而不是范围的宽度。

normalIntro.en: Real word parts: broad + -en, the same native pattern as widen, deepen, and strengthen; broad itself goes back to Old English brād.
normalIntro.cn: 真实构词：broad + -en，与 widen、deepen、strengthen 同一本土模式；broad 本身上溯古英语 brād。

normal.en: broad + -en = broaden, exactly like wide + -en = widen and deep + -en = deepen. The suffix means 'make or become'.
normal.cn: broad + -en = broaden，正如 wide + -en = widen、deep + -en = deepen。后缀意为“使……或变得……”。

normal.en: To broaden the scope is to push both side limits of an inquiry outward, so that more cases fit inside.
normal.cn: 扩大范围（broaden the scope）就是把调查的两侧界限向外推，让更多案例装进去。

normal.en: Horizons are the far edge of what you can see; broadening them moves that edge farther away.
normal.cn: horizons 是你能看见的远边界；把它拓宽，就是把那条边界推得更远。

normal.en: A river broadens out where it opens into a lake: the verb can be intransitive, with no one doing the widening.
normal.cn: 河流展开成湖时会 broaden out：这个动词可以不及物，并没有谁在加宽它。

normal.en: Broaden is the action, broad is the quality, broadly is the viewpoint, and breadth is the measured result: four jobs from one root.
normal.cn: broaden 是动作，broad 是性质，broadly 是视角，breadth 是量出的结果：同一个词根承担四种职能。

abstract.en: A narrow beam turned into a floodlight: the same light, spread over more area, so more of the room is lit.
abstract.cn: 一束窄光变成泛光灯：同样的光铺在更大面积上，于是房间被照亮的范围更大。

abstract.en: A picture frame stretched at both ends: the scene inside does not change, but more of the world now fits in the frame.
abstract.cn: 一个相框两端被拉宽：框里的景象没有变，但能装进框里的世界更多了。

abstract.en: A road given shoulders: the destination stays the same, yet the passage can carry more traffic without becoming a different road.
abstract.cn: 一条路加上了路肩：目的地不变，但这条通道能承载更多往来，而不会变成另一条路。

examples.en: Reading foreign novels broadened her sense of what a family can be.
examples.cn: 读外国小说拓宽了她对“家庭可以是什么”的理解。

examples.en: The new policy broadens access to free screening.
examples.cn: 新政策扩大了免费筛查的获取机会。

examples.en: The valley broadens out into farmland beyond the last bridge.
examples.cn: 过了最后一座桥，山谷展开成农田。

dict_mnemonic.text: “布若等”——把一块布（broad）向两边再拉宽一点 → broaden 加宽、扩大

root: broad（古英语 brād“宽的”，原始日耳曼语 *braidi-）+ -en（本土动词后缀，古英语 -nian，原始日耳曼语 *-inojan，表示“使……、变得……”）；更深的原始印欧语来源不确定。

sensesIntro.en: Nine senses of broaden share one motion: push two limits outward. The limits may belong to a road, an inquiry, a mind, an audience, a group, or a river mouth.
sensesIntro.cn: broaden 的九个义项是一个动作：把两条界限向外推。这两条界限可以属于道路、调查、心智、受众、群体或河口。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: two side limits are pushed outward, so the space between them becomes larger.
core.cn: 核心意象：两条侧边界限被向外推，于是它们之间的空间变大。

branches.en: PHYSICAL: a road or opening gains width, the literal starting point of the verb.
branches.cn: 物理：道路或开口增加宽度，这是动词的字面起点。

branches.en: SCOPE: the edges become the limits of a study or rule, and both are moved outward.
branches.cn: 范围：边变成研究或规则的界限，两端都被向外移。

branches.en: MIND: the narrow space is inside a person, and experience pushes its walls back.
branches.cn: 心智：狭窄空间在人的内部，经验把它的墙往后推。

branches.en: PEOPLE: an audience or a group is the covered area, so widening becomes inclusion.
branches.cn: 人群：受众或群体就是被覆盖的面积，因此加宽变成包容。

branches.en: FORM AND BOUNDARIES: broaden out opens by itself, widen takes physical width, expand grows in volume, and the verb can be transitive or not.
branches.cn: 形态与边界：broaden out 自行展开，widen 承担物理宽度，expand 是体积增长，而动词可及物也可不及物。

intro.en: Broaden is a clean two-part word: the adjective broad plus the native verb suffix -en. There is no prefix, and the suffix is the same one seen in widen, deepen, and strengthen.
intro.cn: broaden 是干净的两段式：形容词 broad 加本土动词后缀 -en。它没有前缀，这个后缀也见于 widen、deepen、strengthen。

latinIntro.en: There is no Latin ancestry in broaden. Its suffix is native Old English, and the Latin-derived verbs below (extend, expand, enlarge, amplify) are separate words that English borrowed for overlapping ideas, not relatives of broaden.
latinIntro.cn: broaden 没有拉丁语血统。它的后缀是本土古英语；下面的 extend、expand、enlarge、amplify 都是英语为相近概念另借来的拉丁词，不是 broaden 的亲属。

items.meaning: to make or become broad; the suffix changes an adjective of width into a verb of widening
items.meaningCN: 使变宽或变宽；后缀把表宽度的形容词变成表加宽的动词
items.example: They broadened the track to take larger vehicles.
items.exampleCN: 他们把车道加宽，以容纳更大的车辆。

items.meaning: wide in space or large in range; the base that supplies all the meaning of width
items.meaningCN: 空间上宽的，或范围广的；提供全部“宽度”语义的基础词
items.example: A broad street runs through the old town.
items.exampleCN: 一条宽阔的街道穿过老城。

items.meaning: in general terms or over a wide range; the adjective becomes an adverb of manner or viewpoint
items.meaningCN: 大体上，或广泛地；形容词变成表方式或视角的副词
items.example: Broadly speaking, the two accounts agree.
items.exampleCN: 大体而言，两种说法是一致的。

items.structure: broad + -th (noun of a quality), with a vowel change
items.meaning: width, or range of knowledge; the suffix turns the adjective into the measurable quality itself
items.meaningCN: 宽度，或知识广度；后缀把形容词变成可测量的性质本身
items.example: The breadth of her reading impressed the panel.
items.exampleCN: 她阅读的广度让评审小组印象深刻。

items.meaning: the quality of being broad; the regular alternative to breadth
items.meaningCN: 宽的性质；breadth 的规则替代形式
items.example: The broadness of the valley surprised the walkers.
items.exampleCN: 山谷的宽阔让步行者感到惊讶。

items.meaning: to make or become wide; the same suffix applied to a near-synonym of broad
items.meaningCN: 使变宽或变宽；同一后缀加在 broad 的近义词上
items.example: They widened the bridge to ease traffic.
items.exampleCN: 他们把桥加宽以缓解交通。

items.meaning: to make or become deep; another verb of the same native pattern
items.meaningCN: 使变深或变深；同一本土模式的另一个动词
items.example: The channel was deepened to admit larger ships.
items.exampleCN: 航道被加深，以容纳更大的船只。

items.meaning: to make or become strong; the suffix works on a noun here
items.meaningCN: 使变强或变强；这里后缀加在名词上
items.example: The new evidence strengthened their case.
items.exampleCN: 新证据加强了他们的论证。

items.structure: broad + -minded (having a mind of that kind)
items.meaning: willing to accept views different from one's own; the abstract sense of broad in a compound
items.meaningCN: 愿意接受不同观点的；broad 的抽象义用于复合词
items.example: Her broad-minded approach won over the committee.
items.exampleCN: 她开明的态度赢得了委员会的支持。

latinEntries.meaning: to stretch out or lengthen; a Latin-derived counterpart stressing length, not width
latinEntries.meaningCN: 向外伸展或延长；拉丁来源的对应词，强调长度而非宽度

latinEntries.meaning: to spread out and grow larger; a counterpart stressing volume in all directions
latinEntries.meaningCN: 铺开并变大；对应词，强调各方向的体积增长

latinEntries.structure: en- (make) + large, from Latin largus 'abundant, generous'
latinEntries.meaning: to make larger overall; a counterpart stressing total size
latinEntries.meaningCN: 使整体变大；对应词，强调总体尺寸

latinEntries.meaning: to make larger, stronger, or fuller; a counterpart often used for sound and signals
latinEntries.meaningCN: 使更大、更强或更充分；对应词，常用于声音与信号

definition_zh: 推理；论证；推理能力；思路
definition_en: the process of thinking in steps from evidence to a conclusion, or the argument that results
core_image: 白板上三行证据，箭头一条接一条，最后指向一个被圈起来的结论
scene: 辩论社的教室里，学生把三条证据依次写在白板上，再用箭头标出它们指向的结论。 Her reasoning moved step by step from three observations to one careful conclusion.
sceneCN: 这里 reasoning 指「由证据一步步推到结论的过程」（第 1 个义项：推理过程）；句意为她的推理从三条观察一步一步走到一个谨慎的结论。

pos.zh: 推理；论证；推理能力（不可数指过程，可数指一套论证）

forms.label: 形容词（作定语，如推理过程）

derivatives.zh: 原因；理性 / 推理（本词的动词原形，拉丁词根意为「计算、思量」）
理性的；合理的（同词根加形容词后缀，指合乎计算与权衡）
理由说明；原理（同词根的名词，指一套背后的道理）
推理者（动词加表施动者的后缀）

senses.title: The process of drawing a conclusion
senses.definition: the mental process of moving in steps from evidence or premises to a conclusion
senses.definitionCN: 从证据或前提出发、分步骤走向结论的心理过程
senses.example: Her reasoning moved step by step from three observations to one careful conclusion.
senses.exampleCN: 她的推理从三条观察一步步走到一个谨慎的结论。
senses.why: The Latin noun meant 'reckoning', so reasoning is the mind doing arithmetic on ideas.
senses.whyCN: 拉丁名词意为「计算」，所以推理就是心智在对观念做算术。

senses.title: A chain of argument
senses.definition: the linked statements produced by that process, viewed as an object one can inspect
senses.definitionCN: 由该过程产生的、可被逐条检视的关联陈述
senses.example: The examiner could not fault the reasoning, only the data.
senses.exampleCN: 考官挑不出这套论证的毛病，只能挑数据的毛病。
senses.why: Once the steps are written down, the process becomes a structure that others can check.
senses.whyCN: 一旦步骤被写下来，过程就变成一个别人可以核查的结构。

senses.title: The faculty of reason
senses.definition: the underlying power of mind that makes such step-by-step thinking possible
senses.definitionCN: 使这种分步思考得以发生的底层心智能力
senses.example: Reasoning is what separates a proof from an assertion.
senses.exampleCN: 正是理性能力把证明与断言区别开来。
senses.why: A process needs a power behind it, and the same noun names both the doing and the capacity.
senses.whyCN: 过程背后需要一种能力，同一个名词因此既指所做之事，也指那种能力。

senses.title: A trainable skill
senses.definition: the capacity as something that can be improved by practice and instruction
senses.definitionCN: 可以通过练习与教学提高的那种能力
senses.example: The course teaches reasoning through puzzles rather than lectures.
senses.exampleCN: 这门课用谜题而不是讲授来训练推理能力。
senses.why: What can be learned can be named as a skill, and the word shifts from a gift to a curriculum.
senses.whyCN: 能被学会的东西可以被命名为技能，这个词于是从天赋转为课程内容。

senses.title: A line of reasoning
senses.definition: the particular route a thinker takes, including its starting point and its order
senses.definitionCN: 思考者所走的具体路径，包括起点与顺序
senses.example: I lost the line of reasoning when the speaker changed examples.
senses.exampleCN: 讲者换了例子，我就跟不上这条思路了。
senses.why: Two people can reach the same end by different routes, so the word also names the route.
senses.whyCN: 两个人可以走不同的路径到达同一终点，因此这个词也指那条路径。

senses.title: Legal reasoning
senses.definition: the disciplined method by which courts apply rules to facts
senses.definitionCN: 法院把规则适用于事实时所遵循的受训练的方法
senses.example: Legal reasoning binds the conclusion to the statute, not to the judge's mood.
senses.exampleCN: 法律推理把结论绑在法条上，而不是绑在法官的情绪上。
senses.why: Courts must show that a result follows from published rules, so this is the same step-taking under an institutional constraint.
senses.whyCN: 法院必须表明结果是由公布过的规则推出的，因此这是同一套分步思考在制度约束下的形态。

senses.title: Faulty reasoning
senses.definition: thinking that breaks a rule of inference while still sounding persuasive
senses.definitionCN: 违反推理规则、听起来却仍有说服力的思考
senses.example: The report's faulty reasoning survived because nobody checked the second step.
senses.exampleCN: 那份报告的推理有谬误，却因为没人核查第二步而留了下来。
senses.why: A step can be skipped while the surface still persuades, and the word marks exactly that kind of failure.
senses.whyCN: 步骤可以被跳过而表面仍有说服力，这个词标记的正是这类失败。

senses.title: Mathematical reasoning
senses.definition: the form of step-by-step thinking that works with symbols, definitions and proofs
senses.definitionCN: 以符号、定义与证明为对象的分步思考形式
senses.example: Mathematical reasoning demands that every step be justified.
senses.exampleCN: 数学推理要求每一步都有依据。
senses.why: Symbols strip away subject matter and leave only relations, which is the purest version of the same walking.
senses.whyCN: 符号剥去题材，只留下关系，这是同一种行走最纯粹的版本。

intro.en: Reasoning is the English noun formed from the verb reason with the ending that names an activity. The Latin source is a noun meaning 'reckoning' or 'account'.
intro.cn: reasoning 是由动词 reason 加表活动的词尾构成的英语名词。它的拉丁来源是一个意为「计算、账目」的名词。

items.en: The verb meant 'to reckon, calculate, think'. Thinking was pictured as counting, which is why the family keeps the image of a sum.
items.cn: 这个动词意为「计算、估量、思考」。思考被描绘成数数，因此这个词族一直保留着「求和」的画面。

items.en: The noun meant 'reckoning, account, method, reason'. It could name a business account as easily as a chain of thought.
items.cn: 这个名词意为「计算、账目、方法、理性」。它既能指生意上的账，也能指一串思路。

items.en: The past participle meant 'reckoned, settled, fixed'. What has been settled can be relied on, which explains the later sense of something confirmed.
items.cn: 过去分词意为「已算清、已定下、已固定」。算清的东西可以依靠，这解释了后来「已确认」的意思。

items.en: Old French carried the noun into English in the twelfth century, where it first named a statement offered in explanation or defence.
items.cn: 古法语在 12 世纪把这个名词带入英语，最初指为解释或辩护而提出的说法。

items.en: The verbal noun in -ing was fixed in the sixteenth century for the activity of drawing conclusions, and later for the argument produced.
items.cn: 带这个动名词词尾的说法在 16 世纪固定下来，指得出结论的活动，后又指所产生的论证。

items.en: Source uncertain: the deeper Indo-European root proposed for the verb is a reconstructed form, and the exact relation between the counting and thinking senses is not settled.
items.cn: 来源不确定：为该动词提出的更深印欧词根属重构形式，「计算」与「思考」两义的确切关系也没有定论。

note.en: The first group holds forms and relatives of one root that get swapped in writing; the second holds other names for thinking in steps.
note.cn: 第一组是同一词根的形式与亲属词，写作时常被互换；第二组是其他表示「分步思考」的名称。

entries.definition: The base verb and the noun for the faculty or a cause; reasoning is the activity or its product.
entries.definitionCN: 基础动词，以及指官能或原因的名词；reasoning 指活动本身或其产物。

entries.definition: Same root, but it names the explanation offered for a decision rather than the steps taken to reach it.
entries.definitionCN: 同词根，但指为一个决定给出的说明，而非走到它的那些步骤。

entries.definition: It describes a person or act as following reason; it never names the chain of steps.
entries.definitionCN: 形容人或行为合乎理性；它从不指那串步骤。

entries.definition: From a Greek word for word and reason: it names the system of rules that reasoning should follow.
entries.definitionCN: 来自希腊语中指「言辞、理性」的词：指推理应当遵循的那套规则。

entries.definition: The complete case, premises plus conclusion, often with the purpose of persuading.
entries.definitionCN: 完整的论证，包括前提与结论，常带说服目的。

entries.definition: One move from what is known to what follows; reasoning is the whole series of such moves.
entries.definitionCN: 从已知到推出的单步；reasoning 是这类步骤的整串。

entries.definition: Any mental activity at all, including imagining and remembering, where reasoning must be disciplined.
entries.definitionCN: 泛指任何心理活动，包括想象与回忆，而推理必须是受约束的。

normalIntro.en: Normal associations: real morphemes, real fixed phrases and real relatives, not invented rhymes.
normalIntro.cn: 正常联想：真实的构词成分、真实固定搭配与真实同族词，而非编造的顺口溜。

normal.en: The Latin noun meant 'reckoning', so reasoning is counting your way to a conclusion.
normal.cn: 拉丁名词意为「计算」，所以推理就是一路数到结论。

normal.en: The family runs reason, reasoning, rational, rationale, reasoner.
normal.cn: 同族词包括 reason、reasoning、rational、rationale、reasoner。

normal.en: Fixed phrases mark it as a route: a line of reasoning, follow the reasoning, sound reasoning.
normal.cn: 固定搭配把它标成一条路线：思路、跟上论证、可靠的推理。

normal.en: Two fields give it a fixed form: legal reasoning and mathematical reasoning.
normal.cn: 两个领域给了它固定形态：法律推理与数学推理。

normal.en: The word names both the activity and the written argument it leaves behind.
normal.cn: 这个词既指活动，也指活动留下的那套书面论证。

abstract.en: Picture stepping stones across water, each one close enough to reach.
abstract.cn: 想象水面上的一串踏脚石，每一块都近得够得着。

abstract.en: Picture a receipt for every claim, kept in a drawer.
abstract.cn: 想象每一个主张都有一张收据，收在抽屉里。

abstract.en: Picture a route drawn on a map, with the crossings numbered.
abstract.cn: 想象地图上画出的一条路线，每个转折都编了号。

examples.en: The judge praised the clarity of the student's reasoning.
examples.cn: 评委称赞这名学生论证清晰。

examples.en: One weak link in the reasoning brought down the whole conclusion.
examples.cn: 论证中一个薄弱的环节让整个结论垮掉。

examples.en: Training in reasoning improves performance on unfamiliar problems.
examples.cn: 推理训练能提高解决陌生问题的表现。

dict_mnemonic.text: reason（计算、思量）+ ing（进行中）＝ 一步步算下去的过程 → 推理、论证。

root: 来自拉丁名词 ratio「计算、账目、方法、理性」，源自 reri「计算、思量」，过去分词 ratus 意为「已算清、已定下」；更早印欧词根属重构形式。同族有 reason、rational、rationale、ratify。

sensesIntro.en: Eight senses follow one walk: step after step from what is known to what follows. The walk can be named as an activity, inspected as a written chain, traced to the power behind it, trained, followed as a route, fixed by law, broken by error, or sharpened into proof.
sensesIntro.cn: 八个义项沿一次行走展开：从已知之物一步一步走到随之而来的结论。这次行走可以作为活动被命名、作为书面链条被检视、被追到背后的能力、被训练、被当作路线跟随、被法律固定、被错误打断，或被磨成证明。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: stepping stones laid across water, one after another.
core.cn: 核心意象：一块接一块铺过水面的踏脚石。

branches.en: WALK AND WALKER: the activity, and the capacity that makes anyone able to take the steps.
branches.cn: 行走与行路人：活动本身，以及使任何人能迈出这些步骤的能力。

branches.en: CHAIN AND ROUTE: the finished series, and the particular path chosen through it.
branches.cn: 链条与路线：完成的整串，以及在其中的那条具体路径。

branches.en: TRAINED FEET: what can be practised becomes a skill with exercises.
branches.cn: 受过训练的脚：可以练习的东西变成有习题的技能。

branches.en: TWO DISCIPLINED FORMS: the courtroom and the proof both insist that every step be licensed.
branches.cn: 两种受约束的形式：法庭与证明都坚持每一步都要有依据。

branches.en: THE BROKEN STEP: one unjustified move is enough to bring the whole path down.
branches.cn: 断掉的一步：一个没有依据的动作就足以让整条路塌掉。

intro.en: Reasoning is a verb plus an ending that turns it into the name of an activity, and the root behind the verb also builds several abstract nouns.
intro.cn: reasoning 是动词加一个使它成为活动名称的词尾，动词背后的词根还构成若干抽象名词。

latinIntro.en: The reckoning root gives the noun for an account, the adjective for what is calculated, and the noun for a stated ground.
latinIntro.cn: 这个「计算」词根给出指账目的名词、指「已算定的」形容词，以及指所陈理由的名词。

items.example: The root treats thought as a kind of counting.
items.exampleCN: 这个词根把思考当作一种数数。

items.example: The noun covers both a ledger and a chain of thought.
items.exampleCN: 这个名词同时涵盖账簿与思路。

items.structure: reason (English noun and verb, from the Latin noun)
items.meaning: a cause; the faculty; to think
items.example: She reasoned until the answer appeared.
items.exampleCN: 她一路推理，直到答案出现。

items.example: The ending turns a verb into the name of its activity.
items.exampleCN: 这个词尾把动词变成其活动的名称。

items.example: Her reasoning moved from evidence to conclusion.
items.exampleCN: 她的推理从证据走到结论。

items.example: A rational choice can still be a wrong one.
items.exampleCN: 合乎理性的选择仍可能选错。

items.example: The report gave no rationale for the cut.
items.exampleCN: 报告没有为这次削减给出理由。

items.example: A careful reasoner checks the second step.
items.exampleCN: 谨慎的推理者会核查第二步。

items.example: What is reckoned and settled can be formally confirmed.
items.exampleCN: 算清并定下的事可以被正式确认。

latinEntries.structure: reri, ratus sum (deponent verb, third conjugation)

derivatives.zh: 原因；理性 / 推理（本词的动词原形，拉丁词根意为「计算、思量」）
理性的；合理的（同词根加形容词后缀，指合乎计算与权衡）
理由说明；原理（同词根的名词，指一套背后的道理）
推理者（动词加表施动者的后缀）

definition_zh: 处理；加工；对数据、信号、材料或申请按步骤进行的一系列操作
definition_en: the act of carrying out a series of operations on data, signals, materials or requests
core_image: 实验室里一排样本瓶沿着传送带依次经过过滤、加热与读数三站
scene: 实验室把一批水样送进仪器，机器按顺序完成过滤、加热和读数。 The processing of the samples took most of the afternoon.
sceneCN: 这里指按步骤对材料或数据作一系列操作（第 1 个义项：按步骤进行操作的过程）；句意为样品的处理占了下午大半时间。图中可辨识物件：水样瓶、仪器、流程卡、记录表。

pos.zh: 处理；加工；处理过程

senses.title: Carrying out a series of steps
senses.definition: the carrying out of a series of operations on materials, data or requests to bring them to a usable state
senses.definitionCN: 对材料、数据或请求执行一系列操作、使其达到可用状态的过程
senses.example: The processing of the samples took most of the afternoon.
senses.exampleCN: 样品的处理占了下午大半时间。
senses.why: Processing is the activity noun of process, and the core sense is a series of steps applied to a material.
senses.whyCN: 这个词由动词「进行」加活动词尾构成，核心义就是对材料施加一系列步骤。

senses.title: Food processing
senses.definition: the treatment of food by heat, pressure, drying or chemicals to preserve or transform it
senses.definitionCN: 用加热、加压、干燥或化学方法保存或改变食物
senses.example: Food processing removes water so the fruit keeps longer.
senses.exampleCN: 食品加工去除水分，使水果保存更久。
senses.why: Food is the oldest material put through a process, and the word keeps that kitchen and factory sense.
senses.whyCN: 食物是最早被按步骤处理的材料，这个词保留了厨房与工厂的那层意思。

senses.title: Signal processing
senses.definition: the analysis and transformation of electronic signals to remove noise or extract information
senses.definitionCN: 对电子信号进行分析与变换，以去噪或提取信息
senses.example: Signal processing cleaned the recording of the bird song.
senses.exampleCN: 信号处理把鸟鸣录音里的杂音清理干净。
senses.why: A signal is a stream, and processing is what turns a noisy stream into a readable one.
senses.whyCN: 信号是一股流，处理就是把嘈杂的流变成可读的东西。

senses.title: Natural language processing
senses.definition: the use of computers to analyse and generate human language
senses.definitionCN: 用计算机分析与生成人类语言
senses.example: Natural language processing now sorts the complaints by topic.
senses.exampleCN: 自然语言处理如今按主题给投诉分类。
senses.why: Language becomes data, and the same step-by-step treatment is applied to words.
senses.whyCN: 语言变成数据，同一套按步骤的处理被施加到词上。

senses.title: Payment processing
senses.definition: the authorisation and settlement of card or bank payments between parties
senses.definitionCN: 在各方之间完成银行卡或银行支付的授权与结算
senses.example: Payment processing failed twice before the order went through.
senses.exampleCN: 支付处理失败了两次，订单才通过。
senses.why: Money moves as a series of checks, and the checks are the processing.
senses.whyCN: 钱以一连串核验的方式移动，这些核验就是处理。

senses.title: Image processing
senses.definition: the manipulation of digital pictures to improve, measure or recognise their content
senses.definitionCN: 对数字图像进行操纵，以改善、测量或识别其内容
senses.example: Image processing sharpened the blurred plate number.
senses.exampleCN: 图像处理让模糊的车牌变清晰了。
senses.why: A picture is a grid of numbers, and processing is the arithmetic performed on that grid.
senses.whyCN: 图像是一格格数字，处理就是对那一格格数字做运算。

senses.title: Industrial material processing
senses.definition: the treatment of raw materials by physical or chemical means in manufacturing
senses.definitionCN: 在制造中用物理或化学手段处理原料
senses.example: The plant's processing of ore uses less water than it did before.
senses.exampleCN: 这家工厂的矿石加工比过去用水更少。
senses.why: This is the factory floor again: raw material enters, treated material leaves.
senses.whyCN: 这又回到工厂车间：原料进去，处理过的材料出来。

senses.title: Handling an application
senses.definition: the official steps by which a request, claim or document is examined and decided
senses.definitionCN: 审查并决定请求、索赔或文件的官方步骤
senses.example: Visa processing can take six weeks in summer.
senses.exampleCN: 夏季签证处理可能需要六周。
senses.why: A request is treated as a material that must pass through stages before it is finished.
senses.whyCN: 一项请求被当作必须经过若干阶段才完成的材料。

senses.title: Central processing
senses.definition: the execution of instructions by the main unit of a computer
senses.definitionCN: 由计算机主单元执行指令
senses.example: Central processing is fast, but the disk is still the slow part.
senses.exampleCN: 中央处理很快，但磁盘仍是慢的那一环。
senses.why: The computing sense narrows the act to the chip, where the steps happen in order at great speed.
senses.whyCN: 计算义把这动作收窄到芯片上，步骤在那里以极快速度依次发生。

intro.en: Processing is process plus -ing. Process came from Latin processus 'advance', from procedere 'to go forward' (pro- 'forward' plus cedere 'to go'). It shares its root with processor, but names the activity rather than the agent.
intro.cn: processing 是 process 加 -ing。process 来自拉丁 processus「前进」，上溯 procedere「向前走」（pro-「向前」加 cedere「走」）。它与 processor 同根，但命名的是活动而非执行者。

items.en: Latin procedere meant to go forward, built from pro- 'forward' and cedere 'to go, yield'.
items.cn: 拉丁 procedere 指向前走，由 pro-「向前」与 cedere「走、让」构成。

items.en: Processus named an advance or a course of events, and English process kept the sense of ordered steps.
items.cn: processus 指前进或事件进程，英语 process 保留「有序步骤」之意。

items.en: The ending -ing turns the verb into a noun of activity, so processing is the carrying out of the steps, not the thing that carries them.
items.cn: 词尾 -ing 把动词变成活动名词，因此 processing 指执行步骤，而非执行步骤的东西。

items.en: In the nineteenth century processing named the treatment of food and raw materials in factories.
items.cn: 十九世纪，processing 指工厂中对食物与原料的加工。

items.en: From the mid-twentieth century the word was applied to data, signals and images, where the material is invisible.
items.cn: 二十世纪中期起，这个词被用于数据、信号与图像，材料变成不可见之物。

items.en: Processor names the doer with -or and processing names the doing with -ing, so the pair keeps the two sides of one Latin verb.
items.cn: processor 用 -or 命名执行者，processing 用 -ing 命名执行，两者保留同一个拉丁动词的两面。

note.en: The first group looks or sounds like processing; the second group names neighbouring ideas in the same field.
note.cn: 第一组在形音上与「processing」相近；第二组是同一领域里意思相邻的其他说法。

entries.definition: The base noun and verb, naming the course of steps without the activity ending.
entries.definitionCN: 基础名词与动词，指步骤过程，不带活动词尾。

entries.definition: The doer of the process, formed with the agent suffix; it is not the activity.
entries.definitionCN: 过程的执行者，由施动后缀构成，不是活动本身。

entries.definition: The participle describing material that has already gone through the steps.
entries.definitionCN: 描述已走过这些步骤的材料的分词。

entries.definition: A forward-moving line of people, from the same verb but a different branch.
entries.definitionCN: 向前行进的队伍，同出那个动词但属另一支。

entries.definition: An action or a legal case, closer to the forward-movement sense of the Latin verb.
entries.definitionCN: 行动或法律程序，更近拉丁动词「向前」那一义。

entries.definition: The application of a process to a material or a patient, often in one round.
entries.definitionCN: 对材料或病人施加一次处理，常指一轮。

entries.definition: The managing or moving of something, with less emphasis on ordered steps.
entries.definitionCN: 对某物的管理或搬运，较少强调有序步骤。

entries.definition: The carrying out of calculations, a narrower kind of processing.
entries.definitionCN: 执行计算，是 processing 更窄的一种。

entries.definition: The removal of impurities or rough parts, one kind of material processing.
entries.definitionCN: 去除杂质或粗糙部分，是材料处理的一种。

normalIntro.en: Normal associations use the real Latin forward verb, the real -ing suffix and real technical phrases.
normalIntro.cn: 正常联想使用真实的拉丁「向前」动词、真实 -ing 后缀与真实技术搭配。

normal.en: Process comes from Latin procedere, to go forward, and -ing names the activity rather than the doer.
normal.cn: process 来自拉丁 procedere「向前走」，-ing 命名活动而非执行者。

normal.en: Processor and processing share one root: the doer and the doing.
normal.cn: processor 与 processing 同根：执行者与执行。

normal.en: Fixed phrases mark the branches: data processing, signal processing, food processing, payment processing.
normal.cn: 固定说法标出各支：数据处理、信号处理、食品加工、支付处理。

normal.en: Natural language processing applies the same steps to words.
normal.cn: 自然语言处理把同样的步骤施加到词上。

normal.en: Image processing is arithmetic performed on a grid of numbers.
normal.cn: 图像处理是对一格格数字做运算。

abstract.en: Processing is a conveyor belt: each stage hands the thing to the next.
abstract.cn: 处理是一条传送带：每一站把东西交给下一站。

abstract.en: The material changes shape, but the order of steps is what makes it reliable.
abstract.cn: 材料改变形态，而可靠性来自步骤的顺序。

abstract.en: Nothing is finished until the last stage lets it go.
abstract.cn: 直到最后一站放手，东西才算完成。

examples.en: The processing of the visa took longer than the flight itself.
examples.cn: 签证的处理比飞行本身还久。

examples.en: Signal processing removed most of the wind noise from the recording.
examples.cn: 信号处理去掉了录音里的大部分风声。

examples.en: Food processing often adds salt, so the label must say so.
examples.cn: 食品加工常加盐，因此标签必须注明。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「破塞行」——把活一件件塞进去、按顺序做出来，就是处理

root: process 来自拉丁 processus「前进」，上溯 procedere「向前走」（pro- 向前 + cedere 走）；加 -ing 构成活动名词 processing。与 processor 同根，一为执行者，一为执行。

sensesIntro.en: Nine senses follow one series of steps: data handled, food treated, signals cleaned, language analysed, payments settled, images sharpened, ore processed, applications examined, and instructions executed.
sensesIntro.cn: 九个义项跟着同一串步骤：数据处理、食物加工、信号清理、语言分析、支付结算、图像锐化、矿石处理、申请审查，以及指令执行。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: sample bottles moving along a belt through filtering, heating and reading.
core.cn: 核心意象：一排样本瓶沿传送带依次经过过滤、加热与读数三站。

branches.en: THE STEPPED ACT: data or instructions are taken through a fixed order of operations.
branches.cn: 按步骤的动作：数据或指令被带过一套固定顺序的操作。

branches.en: THE MATERIAL: food and ore are changed by heat, pressure or chemistry.
branches.cn: 材料：食物与矿石被加热、加压或化学作用改变。

branches.en: THE INVISIBLE MATERIAL: signals and images are streams and grids that are cleaned by arithmetic.
branches.cn: 不可见的材料：信号与图像是靠运算清理的流与网格。

branches.en: THE SYMBOLIC MATERIAL: words and applications are also put through ordered stages.
branches.cn: 符号材料：词与申请也要经过有序阶段。

branches.en: THE MONEY: authorisation and settlement are the processing of a payment.
branches.cn: 金钱：授权与结算就是一笔支付的处理。

intro.en: Processing is process plus -ing, built on the Latin verb procedere.
intro.cn: processing 是 process 加 -ing，建立在拉丁动词 procedere 上。

latinIntro.en: Latin procedere gives processus and English process; English adds -ing to name the activity, while -or names the doer in processor.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁 procedere 衍生 processus 与英语 process；英语加 -ing 命名活动，而 processor 用 -or 命名执行者。

items.example: The source of the whole family.
items.exampleCN: 整个词族的来源。

items.example: The noun behind process.
items.exampleCN: process 背后的名词。

items.meaning: a course of steps; to treat
items.example: English kept order and movement.
items.exampleCN: 英语保留顺序与运动。

items.example: The suffix names the doing.
items.exampleCN: 后缀命名执行。

items.example: The agent suffix names the doer.
items.exampleCN: 施动后缀命名执行者。

items.example: The participle describes the result.
items.exampleCN: 分词描述结果。

items.example: The prefix repeats the steps.
items.exampleCN: 前缀重复步骤。

items.example: It builds processing and handling.
items.exampleCN: 它构成 processing 与 handling 等词。

definition_zh: 反驳；对指责或论点作出的驳斥；辩论中的反驳发言；法律上提出的反证
definition_en: a reply that answers an accusation or argument and tries to disprove it
core_image: 一只手把对方推过来的石块原样顶回去，石块落地，桌面重新空出来
scene: 对方刚说完质疑，发言人没有回避，而是拿出两份记录逐条把质疑顶了回去。 Her rebuttal used the same data to reach the opposite conclusion.
sceneCN: 这里指用证据把对方质疑驳回去的回应（第 1 个义项：驳斥对方论点的回应）；句意为她的反驳用同一批数据得出了相反的结论。

pos.zh: 反驳；驳斥；反证

derivatives.zh: 由同一法语词干构成的动词，义为「反驳；驳斥」
加已然词尾，义为「已被驳斥的」
加表示「可……的」形容词尾，义为「可反驳的」
加施动者名词尾，义为「反驳者；法律上的答辩」
加行为名词尾，义为「反驳动作」

senses.title: A reply that disproves an argument
senses.definition: an answer that gives reasons or evidence showing an argument to be wrong
senses.definitionCN: 给出理由或证据、表明对方论证有误的回应
senses.example: Her rebuttal showed that the earlier figure had been misread.
senses.exampleCN: 她的反驳表明先前那个数字被误读了。
senses.why: The French verb meant to push back, and a rebuttal is exactly the push that returns an attack.
senses.whyCN: 这个法语动词意为「推回」，而反驳正是把攻击推回去的那一推。

senses.title: A speech answering the opponent
senses.definition: the speech in a debate that replies to the other side's case
senses.definitionCN: 辩论中回应对方立论的发言
senses.example: The third speaker delivered the rebuttal in four minutes.
senses.exampleCN: 第三位辩手用四分钟完成了反驳。
senses.why: Debate assigns a slot for the reply, so the word also names that turn at the microphone.
senses.whyCN: 辩论为回应留出一个环节，这个词也指麦克风前的那一轮。

senses.title: Contrary evidence in law
senses.definition: evidence offered to contradict evidence already presented by the other party
senses.definitionCN: 用来推翻对方已提交证据的证据
senses.example: The defence called a witness in rebuttal.
senses.exampleCN: 辩方传唤了一名证人作反证。
senses.why: Courts stage proof and counter-proof, and the counter-proof is literally evidence that pushes back.
senses.whyCN: 法庭上安排证明与反证明，反证明就是字面上把对方推回去的证据。

senses.title: A formal reply to criticism
senses.definition: an official written or spoken answer to public criticism
senses.definitionCN: 对公开批评作出的正式书面或口头答复
senses.example: The agency issued a detailed rebuttal of the audit.
senses.exampleCN: 该机构发布了一份对审计报告的详细反驳。
senses.why: Institutions must answer charges on the record, and that answer is a rebuttal rather than a denial.
senses.whyCN: 机构必须公开回应指控，而这种回应是逐条驳斥，不是一句否认。

senses.title: The section after a counterargument
senses.definition: the part of an essay that answers the opposing view it has just stated
senses.definitionCN: 文章中回应刚刚陈述的对立观点的部分
senses.example: The rebuttal occupies two paragraphs and cites three studies.
senses.exampleCN: 反驳部分占两段，引用了三项研究。
senses.why: Composition teaching pairs the opposing paragraph with an answering paragraph, and this is its name.
senses.whyCN: 写作教学把陈述对方的一段与回应的一段配对，这一段就叫反驳。

senses.title: A data-based refutation
senses.definition: a refutation that rests on measurements or records rather than on rhetoric
senses.definitionCN: 依靠测量或记录而非修辞的驳斥
senses.example: The rebuttal relied on the raw logs, not on the summary table.
senses.exampleCN: 这次反驳依靠原始日志，而不是汇总表。
senses.why: Numbers can push back too, and when they do the word keeps its physical picture.
senses.whyCN: 数字也能推回去，数字一推，这个词就保留着它的物理画面。

senses.title: A quick answer under pressure
senses.definition: an immediate verbal answer to a challenge in an interview or press conference
senses.definitionCN: 在采访或记者会上对质疑的即时口头回应
senses.example: His rebuttal came before the question had finished.
senses.exampleCN: 问题还没问完，他的反驳就来了。
senses.why: The word covers fast replies as well as polished ones, since pushing back needs no rehearsal.
senses.whyCN: 这个词既指打磨过的回应，也指快速回应，因为推回去不需要排练。

senses.title: An answer to a presumption
senses.definition: a legal answer that defeats a presumption the law would otherwise accept
senses.definitionCN: 推翻法律原本会接受的推定所做的答辩
senses.example: The filing offered a rebuttal of the presumption of regularity.
senses.exampleCN: 该文件对「合规推定」提出了抗辩。
senses.why: Law assumes some facts until challenged, and the challenge itself is called a rebuttal.
senses.whyCN: 法律先假定某些事实，直到有人质疑，而这个质疑本身就叫抗辩。

intro.en: Rebuttal comes from Old French rebouter, to push back, built from re- and a verb meaning to thrust. The English noun keeps the physical picture: an argument is struck, and the answer strikes it back.
intro.cn: 这个词来自古法语 rebouter「推回去」，由表示「回」的前缀与意为「顶、推」的动词构成。英语名词保留了物理画面：论证打过来，回应把它顶回去。

items.en: The thrusting verb behind Old French is reconstructed from Frankish; no written form survives, so its exact shape is uncertain.
items.cn: 古法语中表示「顶、推」的动词由法兰克语重构而来；没有书面形式留存，确切形态不确定。

items.en: This verb meant to thrust or push, and it also stands behind the English word butt, to push with the head.
items.cn: 这个动词意为顶、推，英语中表示以头顶撞的词也出自它。

items.en: With the prefix meaning back, the verb meant to repel or drive back an attack.
items.cn: 加上表示「回」的前缀后，动词意为击退、把攻击顶回去。

items.en: English took the verb through law and used it for answering a charge; the first record is approximate.
items.cn: 英语经法律用语引入这个动词，用于回应指控；最早记录为约数。

items.en: The action noun settled into English later and became the standard word for a debate reply.
items.cn: 动作名词较晚在英语中定型，成为辩论回应的标准说法。

items.en: Courts use it for contrary evidence, and composition teaching uses it for the paragraph that answers the opposing view.
items.cn: 法庭用它指反证，写作教学用它指回应对方观点的那一段。

note.en: The first group shares the pushing root or looks close; the second group names the opposing case or a plain denial.
note.cn: 第一组共享「推」词根或形近；第二组指对立方的主张或单纯的否认。

entries.definition: The verb meaning to drive back an argument or charge.
entries.definitionCN: 指把论证或指控顶回去的动词。

entries.definition: The past participle, used for a claim that has been answered.
entries.definitionCN: 过去分词，指已被回应的主张。

entries.definition: Able to be disproved, a common legal adjective.
entries.definitionCN: 指可被推翻的，是常用法律形容词。

entries.definition: A partial refund; its prefix means back but its root means to beat down in price.
entries.definitionCN: 指部分退款；前缀同表「回」，但词根指压价，属另一来源。

entries.definition: To rise against authority; it comes from a word for war, not for pushing.
entries.definitionCN: 指反抗权威；来自表示战争的词，与「推」无关。

entries.definition: To push with the head; the same thrusting verb survives separately.
entries.definitionCN: 指以头顶撞；同一个「顶」动词单独留存下来。

entries.definition: The opposing argument itself, not the reply that defeats it.
entries.definitionCN: 指对立的论证本身，而不是驳倒它的回应。

entries.definition: Proof that a statement is false, often more formal than a rebuttal.
entries.definitionCN: 指证明某陈述为假，通常比反驳更正式。

entries.definition: A statement that something is not true, without the supporting case.
entries.definitionCN: 指声称某事不实，但不带支撑性论证。

entries.definition: A reply, especially one that answers a reply.
entries.definitionCN: 指回应，尤指对回应的再回应。

entries.definition: The neutral word for any answer.
entries.definitionCN: 指任何回应的中性说法。

normalIntro.en: Normal associations use the pushed-back stone, the debate slot and the legal counter-proof.
normalIntro.cn: 正常联想使用被顶回去的石块、辩论环节与法律反证。

normal.en: To rebut is to push back, and a rebuttal is the push itself.
normal.cn: 反驳就是推回去，而「反驳」这个名词就是那一推。

normal.en: The debate phrase is «deliver the rebuttal», a fixed turn in the format.
normal.cn: 辩论中的固定说法是「作反驳」，是赛制里的固定一轮。

normal.en: Rebuttal evidence is the legal phrase for proof that answers proof.
normal.cn: 「反证」是回应证据的证据在法律上的固定说法。

normal.en: A rebuttal comes after a counterargument: first the punch, then the block.
normal.cn: 反驳跟在反方论点之后：先出拳，再格挡。

normal.en: Rebuttal and refutation differ in tone: the first answers in the room, the second proves on paper.
normal.cn: 反驳与驳斥语气不同：前者在场上回应，后者在纸面上证明。

abstract.en: A rebuttal is an argument's immune response: it recognises the foreign claim and expels it.
abstract.cn: 反驳是论证的免疫反应：识别外来主张，再把它排出去。

abstract.en: Pushing back is not the same as refusing; the hand moves, and that movement is the answer.
abstract.cn: 推回去不等于拒之门外；手动了，这一动就是回答。

abstract.en: Whoever answers last sounds right, which is why rebuttal has a fixed place in debate.
abstract.cn: 最后说话的人听起来总有理，所以反驳在辩论里有固定位置。

examples.en: The minister's rebuttal was shorter than the report it answered.
examples.cn: 部长的反驳比它所回应的报告还短。

examples.en: She wrote a point-by-point rebuttal of the reviewer's comments.
examples.cn: 她针对审稿人的意见写了逐条反驳。

examples.en: The defence called two witnesses in rebuttal.
examples.cn: 辩方传唤了两名证人作反证。

dict_mnemonic.text: 读作「瑞巴投」——把对方扔来的球「投」回「瑞」气，就是反驳

root: 古法语 rebouter「推回去」= re-「回」+ 表示顶、推的动词，其更早的法兰克语形式属重构，确切形态不确定。英语十四世纪经法律用语引入动词，十九世纪名词定型为辩论与写作中的「反驳」。

sensesIntro.en: Eight senses run from the courtroom to the press room: disproving a reply, a debate speech, contrary evidence, an answer to criticism, an essay section, a data-based refutation, a quick answer, and a legal answer to a presumption.
sensesIntro.cn: 八个义项从法庭延伸到记者会：驳倒回应、辩论发言、反证、对批评的答复、文章段落、数据驳斥、即时回应、对推定的抗辩。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a stone thrown at a table is met by a hand that sends it straight back.
core.cn: 核心意象：掷向桌面的石块被一只手接住，又原样顶了回去。

branches.en: THE PUSHED REPLY: an answer that drives an attack back, whether polished or instant.
branches.cn: 顶回去的回应：把攻击送回的回答，无论打磨过还是即时的。

branches.en: THE DEBATE SLOT: the turn at the microphone reserved for answering the other side.
branches.cn: 辩论环节：为回应对方而保留的发言轮次。

branches.en: THE LEGAL COUNTER-PROOF: evidence against evidence, and an answer to a legal presumption.
branches.cn: 法律反证：对着证据的证据，以及对法律推定的抗辩。

branches.en: THE PUBLIC ANSWER: an institution's formal response to criticism.
branches.cn: 公开答复：机构对批评的正式回应。

branches.en: THE WRITTEN ANSWER: the essay section and the refutation built on data.
branches.cn: 书面回应：文章段落与以数据为依据的驳斥。

intro.en: Rebuttal comes from a French verb of pushing back, and its root survives in the English word for butting with the head.
intro.cn: 这个词来自法语的「推回」动词，其词根还留在英语中表示以头顶撞的词里。

latinIntro.en: The deeper root is reconstructed, so only the French stages can be cited with confidence.
latinIntro.cn: 更早的词根属重构，只能有把握地引用法语各阶段。

items.example: It turns thrusting into thrusting back.
items.exampleCN: 它把「顶」变成「顶回去」。

items.example: The pushing half of the word.
items.exampleCN: 这是词里「推」的那一半。

items.example: The direct source of English rebut.
items.exampleCN: 这是英语「反驳」动词的直接来源。

items.example: It forms rebuttal from the verb stem.
items.exampleCN: 它由动词词干构成名词「反驳」。

items.example: It forms rebuttable.
items.exampleCN: 它构成「可反驳的」。

items.example: It forms rebutter.
items.exampleCN: 它构成「反驳者」。

items.example: It forms the adjective rebutted.
items.exampleCN: 它构成形容词「已被驳斥的」。

items.example: The English verb that the noun is built from.
items.exampleCN: 这是名词所依托的英语动词。

definition_zh: 前所未有的；史无前例的；空前的；无先例可循的
definition_en: never having happened, existed or been done before, so that no earlier case exists to serve as a guide
core_image: 档案柜里一排旧水位刻线都很低，今年的水痕却高过所有旧线，旁边的人仰头看着新刻痕
scene: 气象站的老档案里，过去一百年的最高水位都低于今年的刻线，工作人员围着新水痕拍照。 The flood reached an unprecedented level last week.
sceneCN: 这里指水位达到从未有过的高度（第 1 个义项：规模或程度前所未有）；句意为上周洪水达到了前所未有的水位。图中可辨识物件：旧档案柜、一排低刻线、高过所有旧线的新水痕、拍照的工作人员。

pos.zh: 前所未有的；史无前例的；空前的

derivatives.zh: 由前缀加「行走」词根构成的名词，义为「先例；在前的」
同一词根的基础动词，义为「先于；走在前面」
由动词加现在分词词尾构成，义为「在前的」
由词干加表示次序的名词词尾构成，义为「优先；优先权」
由本词加副词词尾构成，义为「前所未有地」

senses.title: A scale never reached before
senses.definition: existing at a size or intensity for which no earlier example can be found
senses.definitionCN: 达到一个找不到先前例子的规模或强度
senses.example: The flood reached an unprecedented level last week.
senses.exampleCN: 上周洪水达到了前所未有的水位。
senses.why: The negative prefix removes the earlier case, and the root supplies the walking that came before.
senses.whyCN: 否定前缀去掉了「先前的例子」，词根则提供了「走在前面」的动作。

senses.title: An event with no earlier occurrence
senses.definition: an occurrence that has no previous instance in the record
senses.definitionCN: 在记录中找不到先前实例的事件
senses.example: The resignation was an unprecedented event in the company's history.
senses.exampleCN: 这次辞职在公司历史上是史无前例的事件。
senses.why: The word points to the record book: nothing on the earlier pages matches this page.
senses.whyCN: 这个词指向记录簿：前面几页没有任何内容与此页相符。

senses.title: A speed never seen before
senses.definition: a rate of change faster than any earlier measured rate
senses.definitionCN: 变化速度超过此前任何可测的速率
senses.example: The city grew at an unprecedented speed during those five years.
senses.exampleCN: 那五年里，这座城市以未曾有过的速度扩张。
senses.why: Speed is the dimension most often called unprecedented, because records measure it precisely.
senses.whyCN: 速度是这个词最常修饰的维度，因为记录能精确测量它。

senses.title: Demand or growth beyond all past peaks
senses.definition: a level of demand, growth or pressure higher than every earlier peak
senses.definitionCN: 需求、增长或压力高于此前每一个峰值
senses.example: The port handled unprecedented demand after the storm.
senses.exampleCN: 风暴过后，港口承接了空前的需求。
senses.why: Economists use the word when a curve passes every earlier peak on the chart.
senses.whyCN: 当曲线越过图表上此前每一个峰值，经济学家就用这个词。

senses.title: A ruling with no legal precedent
senses.definition: a decision for which earlier courts or rules provide no model
senses.definitionCN: 此前的判例或规则无法提供范本的裁决
senses.example: The tribunal issued an unprecedented ruling on digital ownership.
senses.exampleCN: 该法庭就数字财产所有权作出了无先例可循的裁决。
senses.why: Law is built on precedent, so a case without one is formally exceptional.
senses.whyCN: 法律建立在先例之上，因此没有先例的案件在形式上就是例外。

senses.title: A rare and extreme natural event
senses.definition: a weather or natural event outside every earlier record for the place
senses.definitionCN: 超出一个地方此前全部记录的天气或自然事件
senses.example: Forecasters called the drought unprecedented for the region.
senses.exampleCN: 预报员称这场干旱是该地区前所未有的。
senses.why: Weather records are long and numeric, which makes the claim testable.
senses.whyCN: 气象记录漫长且数字化，因此这一说法可以被检验。

senses.title: A record-breaking performance
senses.definition: a result that surpasses every previous mark in a sport or field
senses.definitionCN: 超过某项运动或领域此前所有标记的成绩
senses.example: Her unprecedented run broke three national records.
senses.exampleCN: 她前所未有的这一跑打破了三项全国纪录。
senses.why: Sport gives the word a stopwatch and a scoreboard, where being first is measurable.
senses.whyCN: 体育给了这个词一块秒表和一块记分牌，在那里「第一次」是可以测量的。

senses.title: A break with established practice
senses.definition: an action that departs from the usual custom or procedure
senses.definitionCN: 偏离通常惯例或程序的行为
senses.example: The mayor took the unprecedented step of publishing the budget draft.
senses.exampleCN: 市长采取了公布预算草案这一打破常规的做法。
senses.why: Custom, not nature, is the baseline here; the new move has simply never been tried.
senses.whyCN: 这里的基线是惯例而非自然；这一新做法只是从未被尝试过。

senses.title: Something a person has never experienced
senses.definition: an experience outside the whole range of one person's earlier life
senses.definitionCN: 超出一个人此前全部生活范围的经历
senses.example: For the young teacher, the attention was unprecedented.
senses.exampleCN: 对这位年轻教师来说，这样的关注是前所未有的。
senses.why: The record can be personal as well as public: a single life also has earlier pages.
senses.whyCN: 记录既可以是公共的，也可以是个人的：一个人的生活同样有前面的页。

intro.en: Unprecedented is a negative prefix laid over a Latin verb for going before: no earlier case has gone ahead to show the way.
intro.cn: 这个词是一个否定前缀加在一个表示「走在前面」的拉丁动词上：没有先前的例子先走过、指出道路。

items.en: cedere meant to go, to yield, to move along; it is the walking root inside the word.
items.cn: cedere 意为「走、让、前行」，是这个词内部的「行走」词根。

items.en: prae- meant before, so praecedere was to go before someone or something.
items.cn: prae- 表示「在前」，因此 praecedere 意为「走在某人或某物前面」。

items.en: The participle praecedens described what comes first, and English took it as precedent.
items.cn: 分词 praecedens 描述先出现的事物，英语把它借作 precedent。

items.en: A precedent is an earlier case used as a model; the word settled into law and general usage.
items.cn: 先例是被当作范本的先前案例；这个词在法律与一般用法中固定下来。

items.en: The negative prefix denies the existence of such a model, and the adjective ending attaches it to the case at hand.
items.cn: 否定前缀否认存在这样的范本，形容词词尾把它挂到眼前的案件上。

items.en: Statistics, journalism and sport made the adjective a standard way to say that the record book has no matching page.
items.cn: 统计、新闻与体育让这个形容词成为「记录簿里没有相符的一页」的标准说法。

note.en: The first group shares the going-before root or form; the second group names nearby ideas of being beyond all earlier examples.
note.cn: 第一组共享「走在前面」的词根或形音；第二组是与「超出此前所有例子」意思相邻的说法。

entries.definition: An earlier case or decision used as a guide; the noun that the negative adjective denies.
entries.definitionCN: 指被当作指南的先前案例或裁决；正是这个否定形容词所否认的名词。

entries.definition: To come or go before something else in time or order.
entries.definitionCN: 指在时间或顺序上先于某物。

entries.definition: The right to go first, or priority in rank or order.
entries.definitionCN: 指优先前行的权利，或地位、次序上的优先。

entries.definition: In a manner that has never occurred before.
entries.definitionCN: 以从未发生过的方式。

entries.definition: Free from bias; it looks close but its root is judging in advance, not going before.
entries.definitionCN: 指没有偏见的；形近，但其词根是「预先判断」，而非「走在前面」。

entries.definition: Having no equal in quality or degree; it stresses unmatched rank rather than a missing earlier case.
entries.definitionCN: 指质量或程度上无可匹敌；强调无与伦比，而非缺少先例。

entries.definition: Surpassing a measured mark; it is narrower and always tied to a recorded figure.
entries.definitionCN: 指超过某个已测标记；范围更窄，且总与记录数字相连。

entries.definition: New and original; it stresses freshness rather than the absence of any earlier instance.
entries.definitionCN: 指新颖独创；强调新鲜，而非完全没有先前实例。

entries.definition: Being the only one of its kind; it stresses singularity, not historical record.
entries.definitionCN: 指同类中唯一；强调独一无二，而非历史记录。

normalIntro.en: Normal associations use the real Latin go-before image, the real legal idea of precedent, and the real record phrases.
normalIntro.cn: 正常联想使用真实的拉丁「走在前面」意象、真实的法律先例概念，以及真实的记录搭配。

normal.en: pre- means before and cedere means go: a precedent is a case that walked ahead of you.
normal.cn: pre- 是「在前」，cedere 是「走」：先例就是走在你前面的案例。

normal.en: Add un- and no case has walked ahead; the road has never been walked.
normal.cn: 加上 un-，就没有案例走在前头；这条路从未有人走过。

normal.en: Unprecedented scale, unprecedented demand and unprecedented event are three real phrases.
normal.cn: 空前的规模、空前的需求与史无前例的事件是三个真实搭配。

normal.en: Law lives on precedent, so a case without one is professionally shocking.
normal.cn: 法律靠先例生活，因此没有先例的案件在专业上令人震动。

normal.en: The word says nothing about quality, only about the empty earlier pages.
normal.cn: 这个词不评价好坏，只说前面的页是空的。

abstract.en: A record book is a promise that the future will resemble the past; this word announces that it did not.
abstract.cn: 记录簿是一份「未来会像过去」的承诺；这个词宣布它没有兑现。

abstract.en: Unprecedented does not mean better, only unmatched; the first of anything can be the worst.
abstract.cn: 前所未有并不意味着更好，只意味着无从比对；任何「第一次」都可能是最糟的一次。

abstract.en: Every unprecedented event becomes a precedent the moment it is written down.
abstract.cn: 每一个史无前例的事件，在被写下的那一刻就成了先例。

examples.en: The city is preparing for an unprecedented number of visitors this summer.
examples.cn: 这座城市正在为今夏前所未有的游客数量做准备。

examples.en: Scientists described the collapse of the ice shelf as unprecedented in the satellite record.
examples.cn: 科学家称冰架的崩塌在卫星记录中前所未有。

examples.en: The committee took the unprecedented step of reopening the hearing.
examples.cn: 委员会采取了重新开启听证会这一史无前例的举动。

dict_mnemonic.text: 读作「安普瑞西登提德」——前面没有任何「先例」走过

root: 由否定前缀 un- + precedent + 形容词词尾 -ed 构成；precedent 来自拉丁语 praecedere「走在前面」← prae-「在前」+ cedere「走、让」，分词 praecedens。词源链清楚。

sensesIntro.en: Nine senses run from a scale and an event with no earlier case through speed, demand, law, weather, sport and custom to one person's private experience.
sensesIntro.cn: 九个义项从没有先前例子的规模与事件，经过速度、需求、法律、天气、体育与惯例，最后落到一个人的私人经历。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: rows of old marks on a wall all sit low, and the new water stain rises above every one.
core.cn: 核心意象：墙上旧刻线都低低一排，新水痕却高过其中每一条。

branches.en: THE FIRST PAGE: a scale and an event for which the record book is blank.
branches.cn: 第一页：规模与事件在记录簿上都是空白。

branches.en: THE FAST CURVE: speed and demand that pass every earlier peak.
branches.cn: 陡峭曲线：速度与需求越过此前每个峰值。

branches.en: THE EMPTY CASE LAW: a ruling with no earlier court to follow.
branches.cn: 空白判例：裁决没有先前的法庭可循。

branches.en: THE EXTREME MARK: weather beyond the archive and a score beyond the board.
branches.cn: 极端标记：天气超出档案，成绩超出记分牌。

branches.en: THE UNTRIED MOVE: a custom broken and a life that has never met this before.
branches.cn: 未试之举：被打破的惯例，以及一个人从未遇到过的经历。

intro.en: Unprecedented is a negative prefix, a prefix meaning before, a walking root and an adjective ending stacked in one word.
intro.cn: 这个词把否定前缀、表「在前」的前缀、「行走」词根与形容词词尾叠在一个词里。

latinIntro.en: Latin supplies cedere and praecedere; English adds precedent, then un- and -ed to deny any earlier model.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语提供了 cedere 与 praecedere；英语先构成 precedent，再加 un- 与 -ed 否认任何先前范本。

items.example: It denies the existence of the earlier case.
items.exampleCN: 它否认先前案例的存在。

items.example: It sets the direction of the walking.
items.exampleCN: 它规定「走」的方向。

items.example: The root supplies movement.
items.exampleCN: 词根提供移动。

items.example: Prefix and root form the key verb.
items.exampleCN: 前缀与词根合成关键动词。

items.example: It becomes the English noun precedent.
items.exampleCN: 它变成英语名词 precedent。

items.example: The noun is what un- denies.
items.exampleCN: 这个名词正是 un- 所否认的。

items.example: It turns the noun into the adjective.
items.exampleCN: 它把名词变成形容词。

items.example: The verb keeps the walking image.
items.exampleCN: 动词保留行走意象。

items.example: The noun of rank uses the same root.
items.exampleCN: 表次序的名词使用同一词根。

由现在分词构成，义为「在前的」
